Moneycontrol News April 01, 2026 / 12:10 IST In February, Oracle had announced plans to raise up to $50 billion this year to fund its 'rapidly growing' cloud infrastructure business. Thirty thousand Oracle employees woke up on Tuesday to a cold email notifying them that they had been laid off. The time stamp read 6 am. While the full extent of the layoffs could not be immediately learned, the cuts appear to have affected employees globally. "After careful consideration of Oracle's current business needs, we have made the decision to eliminate your role as part of a broader organizational change," copies of the notification email stated. "As a result, today is your last working day." Oracle confirmed the layoffs last week, describing them as part of a restructuring effort to “rebalance resources” while continuing investment in cloud computing and AI infrastructure. Here's the full text of the email the company sent to its employees on Tuesday: We are sharing some difficult news regarding your position. After careful consideration of Oracle's current business needs , we have made the decision to eliminate your role as part of a broader organizational change. As a result, today is your last working day. We are grateful for your dedication, hard work, and the impact you have made during your time with us. After signing your termination paperwork, you will be eligible to receive a severance package subject to the terms and conditions of the severance plan. You will receive an email from DocuSign to your Oracle email address with details on your severance and termination date. Immediate Action Required To receive important follow-up information, including FAQs and separation documents to help you through this transition, you must provide a personal email address. Please click here to submit a personal email address immediately. If you make a submission error, please re-submit a new form. Please Note: The personal email address will only be used for correspondence regarding separation-related information and severance agreements.
